job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and optimize machine learning and AI models for real-world business problems
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end AI solutions
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation
Deploy models using modern frameworks and ensure scalability and performance
Build APIs and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications
Work on NLP, Computer Vision, or Generative AI use cases
Support clients in AI adoption, insights generation, and automation initiatives
Stay current with emerging AI/ML trends and technologies
Key Skills
2 5 years of experience in AI/ML development
Strong programming skills in Python
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn
Experience in data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy)
Understanding of model deployment (Flask, FastAPI, Docker)
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
Strong foundation in statistics, algorithms, and data structures


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
